node.title: Mismatch-chart nongenericity is an alternative joint A-support
node.statement: For a full-external-zero chart (T,Z), scaled endpoint genericity fails at radius |T|-(A-|Z|) iff there are degree-below-(K-|Z|) polynomials g0,g1 such that c_i+P_Z g_i jointly explain the received pair on Z union R for some R subset T of size at least A-|Z|. Thus recursive nongenericity is exactly a second joint agreement support of size at least A extending Z. Supports for distinct joint codeword-pair explanations intersect in at most K-1 coordinates.
